title: Integral-closure charts for one reduced Artinian affine algebra
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and D a reduced Artinian commutative A-algebra. For every point x of the relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] of Spec D -> Spec A, there is a maximal ideal P of D and an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] c:Spec S -> normalization whose image contains x. Here F=D/P has A-algebra map given by the quotient of algebraMap A D, and S=integralClosure A F [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The composite of c with the structural normalization map is Spec(algebraMap A S). The zero ring D is included.

proof.text: For any affine A-algebra D identify its relative normalization with Spec(integralClosure A D). The normalizationOpenCover chart at the whole affine base has full open range by fromNormalization_preimage, hence is an isomorphism. Transport its integral-closure ring through ΓSpecIso for A and D. IsIntegral.map_of_comp_eq in both directions preserves integral elements; ΓSpecIso_naturality proves the resulting structural equation.

IsArtinianRing.equivPi presents D as the finite product of its maximal residue fields with quotient maps as projections. Apply Spec and sigmaSpec, then reindex the finite maximal spectrum by Fin r, obtaining an isomorphism over Spec A to a finite coproduct of residue-field spectra. Apply lem-sbc-finite-affine-normalization-coproduct to this presentation.

Use the coproduct open cover to choose the component containing the inverse image of x. Compose that component affine-normalization isomorphism with its summand inclusion and the normalization coproduct isomorphism. This is an open immersion; the two structural equations give the required equality. Applying the inverse affine isomorphism to the selected point constructs its preimage. For the zero ring the cover has empty index type, so there is no point to choose.

lean.statement:
theorem reduced_artinian_affine_normalization_charts
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (D : Type u) [CommRing D] [Algebra A D]
    [IsArtinianRing D] [_root_.IsReduced D]
    (x : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A D))).normalization) :
    ∃ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    letI := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    letI := ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp (algebraMap A D)).toAlgebra
    let S := integralClosure A F
    ∃ c : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A D))).normalization,
      IsOpenImmersion c ∧
      c ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A D))).fromNormalization =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A S)) ∧ x ∈ Set.range c
